title: Short Term Weight Loss With Liraglutide and Metformin in Infertile Obese PCOS Patients
brief_summary: The aim of this study was to evaluate the impact of short-term weight reduction achieved with 12-week intervention with metformin alone or in combination with liraglutide on oocyte maturity and embryo quality in infertile obese PCOS population.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* polycystic ovary syndrome (rotterdam criteria)
* BMI of 30 kg/m² or higher
* Infertility for IVF with normal male sperm

Exclusion Criteria:

* type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus
* history of carcinoma
* Cushing's syndrome or congenital (non-classic) adrenal hyperplasia
* personal or family history of multiple endocrine neoplasia 2
* significant cardiovascular, kidney or hepatic disease
* the use of medications known or suspected to affect reproductive or metabolic functions
* the use of statins, within 90 days prior to study entry
